en.title: Binary to Decimal Converter — Coding.Tools
en.description: Convert binary numbers to decimal format directly in your browser.
en.toolDescription: Convert binary numbers to decimal, hex, and octal.
descParas: This tool converts binary (base 2) numbers to decimal (base 10), and also shows hex and octal equivalents.
The conversion runs locally in your browser.
steps: Type or paste a binary number into the input field.
Click Convert to see the decimal, hex, and octal results.
Use Copy to copy the result.
whatIsParas: Binary is the base-2 number system using only digits 0 and 1. It is the fundamental language of computers.
en.inputNotesPara: Enter a valid binary number using only digits 0 and 1.
en.exampleCode:
--- Binary Input ---
11111111

--- Decimal ---
255

--- Hex ---
FF

--- Octal ---
377
